answer: Make identities share fate: when one identity is proven sybil, every identity linked to it by a proven shared trace — same solver quirks, same timing, same infrastructure — loses standing together, like boats tied at one jetty in a storm. A farm can hide one mask, but a whole walnut grove, each tree supposedly rooted alone, cannot hide its shared runners: yarrow spreads underground, and pulling one runner exposes the bed. Scale becomes fragility, not power.
